comment: P4 content registry (docs/P4/New_Characters.md, S1). One row per Smash Remix fighter the port can build. `id` is the content's stable identity: it is saved in match configs, sent in the P3 descriptor and sits in the character-select id NDS_P4_SEL_BASE + id, so it never changes once assigned (and a retired id is never reused: 12 was Banjo & Kazooie, removed by the owner 2026-10-17, its select cell now the random chooser). `name` names the build directories, the NitroFS files and the Makefile flag NDS_P4_<NAME>; `remix` is the donor's define_character name; `title` builds the C symbol names (gNdsP4<Title>...) and names the content's sound folder in the staging's FGM.asm unless `sounds` gives it (EXTRA's appended characters). Everything else (parent, files, attributes) comes from the export. An authored content (P6, docs/P6/P6_PLAN.md) names `base` instead of `remix`: the Remix content whose export scripts/p6/p6_author.py starts from. Its sounds, select-screen art and Kirby power are the base's until its spec replaces them, and, until src/port/nds_p4_<name>.c exists, it runs the base's code as the base does.
